title: leandra tetraquetra
intro: Leandra tetraquetra, commonly known as  "Guaco" or "Matico", is a plant species native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. The health benefits of Leandra tetraquetra include its potential to support the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Leandra tetraquetra include its use as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antibacterial agent, which may help to alleviate symptoms of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Leandra tetraquetra include iridoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
